card.name: Nouns after a/the in instructions
card.fires_on: Nouns or articles that start a new noun phrase in instructions, such as 'a' before 'version', 'container' after 'disposal', 'latex' after 'derived from', and 'pregnant' or 'pregnancy' in warnings.

modes.label: Disposal and latex wording
modes.description: Fires on 'container' after sharps disposal and on 'latex' in needle-cap rubber notes.
modes.example: Throw the gray needle cap into the disposal<< container>>. Step 2:Administer Sub

modes.label: Pregnancy in warnings
modes.description: Fires on 'pregnant' or 'pregnancy' in embryo-fetal harm statements and pregnancy checks.
modes.example: afatinib can cause fetal harm when administered to a<< pregnant>> woman.

modes.label: Tutorial text
modes.description: Fires on a short word in programming tutorial prose or code.
modes.example: We will develop<< a>> version of Scribble written in Python.
